title: Personal Security Hygiene Scorecard
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passwordage:account
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(hygiene_score) as avg_hygiene_score min(hygiene_score) as min_hygiene_score by _time profile_name
| sort - _time
value: A weekly hygiene score gives you one top-line trend while still letting each component stay auditable underneath.
implementation: Send personal security hygiene score events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of personal security hygiene score, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps what is happening with personal security hygiene score, so odd changes stand out quickly.
